name: Low Income Health Care Card
summary: A concession card for cheaper health care and some discounts if your income is low, even if you don't get a Centrelink payment.
who: Income below the income test limit.
catches: The pages we checked don't list the income limits. Check the income test on the Services Australia site.

source.label: Services Australia: Low Income Health Care Card

evidence.quote: A concession card to get cheaper health care and some discounts if you're on a low income.
To get a Low Income Health Care Card your income needs to be below the income test limit.
You don’t need to pass an assets test.
